tashel + mwdoa (الموضوعي) — ayah bounding-box review

tashel: classic-layout fit (like madinah, ~6 px residuals, 604/604 pages). mwdoa: golden-medallion marker detection — red ellipses are the detected end-of-ayah medallions, colored rects the generated per-ayah segments (one color per ayah). Pinch-zoom freely.
